red_state_definition: tests/test_adapter_acceptance_v10_g3.py imports research.adapter_v10, which does not exist at G3 commit time; the module therefore fails at pytest collection (ModuleNotFoundError) and every acceptance assertion in it is UNEXECUTED-RED. That red state is the evidence that the acceptance suite blocks the interface BEFORE implementation. No skip/xfail/loosening was used.
command_note: --continue-on-collection-errors is REQUIRED so the collection error of the RED acceptance file does not abort the whole session; without it pytest interrupts before running the executed-green file.
exit_code_interpretation: 1 = tests ended with errors: exactly the 1 intended collection error; 33 executed tests all passed.
verdict_scope: G3 QA lane only: the lane delivered its own acceptance/fault artifacts and its executable tests are green; the adapter-facing suite is intentionally RED until G1/G2 integrate.
frozen_interface_assumptions_for_a1_revi: Package research/adapter_v10 exports ADAPTER_INTERFACE_VERSION, GenericRunnerV10, checked_funding_accrual, cache_decision, resource_cap_report, validate_resource_cap_report.

GenericRunnerV10(strategy=..., config=...) exposes: compute_fold_metrics(unit_gross_returns_by_fold) -> {'folds':[{fold_id, n_days, expectancy, profit_factor, max_drawdown}], 'aggregate':{...}}; convert_target_book(decision_ns, target_book, prior_weights, events, tick_sizes=None, stress=None, force_flat_boundary_ns=None) -> {'decision_ns','fills','turnover_one_side','cost_per_unit_gross','is_force_flat_boundary','force_flat_reason'}; schedule(scenario) -> M01-shaped rows; finalise_schedule_payload(schedule); stress_variants(cohort, fold_labels) -> [{'id','family','stress'}]; finalize_stress(results_by_variant_id, required_ids); publish_trial(entry, ledger_path=...); denominator(ledger_path=...).

Fill payload entries carry the M01 fill vocabulary: symbol, target_weight, prior_weight, status='FILLED_NEXT_EVENT', applied, event_offset, price, fill_open_ns, fill_bar_close_ns, signed_weight_change.

Fold metric conventions frozen by G3: expectancy = arithmetic mean of unit-gross net returns; profit_factor = sum(wins)/abs(sum(losses)) pooled; max_drawdown = worst relative decline of the compounded equity path (1 - equity/peak).

Stress variant identity grammar: 'baseline | fee_slippage_x1_5 | plus_2_ticks | plus_1_event_delay | drop_one_symbol:<SYMBOL> | drop_one_fold:<LABEL>' with family set exactly {'baseline'} + research.contract_v10.STRESS_MATRIX_V10; fees cell fee_multiplier=1.5; ticks cell tick_slip_ticks=floor+2; delay cell event_delay_events=1.

Benchmark payload keys frozen: flat_hard -> {'daily_unit_gross_return','total_return','expectancy','profit_factor_is_undefined','benchmark','role'='hard_gate'}; context_benchmark(kind=...) -> {'daily_unit_gross_return','role'='context_only'} with neutral_ret[i] = pnl[i]/gross[i] - btc[i]*net[i]/gross[i].

checked_funding_accrual(holdings, settlements, coverage_required=True) -> {'cashflows':[{'symbol','settle_ts_ns','cashflow_per_unit_capital', ...}], 'coverage':{'is_complete','unavailable_spans'}, 'sign_convention'='LONG_PAYS_POSITIVE_RATE', 'status'}; uncovered span => status UNAVAILABLE_FAIL_CLOSED and NO cashflows.

cache_decision(payload_or_path) -> {'enabled','mode','reasons','raw_reads_pair','preregistered_budget_max_raw_reads'}; enabled=true ONLY with raw_reads_pair(cached<=uncached), budget field present, parity+repro proofs true; absent/empty decision or env flag (V10_CACHE_ENABLED) can NEVER enable the cache.

resource_cap_report(payload) computes and validate_resource_cap_report(payload) validates {'owner_ceiling','measured_safe_cap','final_cap' == min(...)} with exactly one integer final_cap; final > measured_safe_cap is INVALID; cap 0 means no local scored launch.
Duplicate/failed publication refusal lives in the adapter publishing layer because research.global_ledger.append_verified has no unique-experiment-id constraint (recorded limitation, H08-12).

findings.finding: research.global_ledger.append_verified accepts a second row with the same experiment identity (no unique constraint); BG-6 exactly-once publication is therefore NOT closed by the ledger layer alone and must be enforced by the G1 adapter/finalizer. Evidence: tests/test_fault_injection_v10_g3.py::test_h08_12_recorded_limitation_probe_raw_registry_has_no_unique_constraint.

research.hyp_a8_m01.funding_cashflows returns [] for a held span with no settlement inside it (silent empty), i.e. the primitive does not itself mark UNAVAILABLE_FAIL_CLOSED. The G2 adapter coverage gate (checked_funding_accrual) must add the marking; gated RED by test_g15_checked_accrual_marks_unavailable_span_fail_closed.

Applying a merged funding series containing two settlement lists that share a timestamp raises DataIntegrityError (duplicate publication stamp) - correct fail-closed behaviour, but callers merging per-symbol cadences must dedupe/stamp distinctly. Evidence: test_g15_mixed_heterogeneous_settlement_cadences_per_symbol.

reasons: G3 lane scope honoured: tests + audit artifacts only, no production implementation touched (git status shows only the three allowlisted new files).

Independence from G1/G2 preserved: no G1/G2 module imported; tests import only research.adapter_v10 (nonexistent, hence RED) plus frozen repo primitives (hyp_a8_m01, cache_v10, global_ledger, resource_governor_v10, pit_hooks_v10, contract_v10).

33 tests execute GREEN now against the real primitives, including hand-computed funding reconciliation (G15), hand-computed cost cells (BG-4), real synthetic-schedule force-flat proof (BG-2) and all nine H08 case 12-20 fault mechanisms.

No assertions were weakened for later integration; the frozen interface assumptions are listed for A1 adjudication before integration.
